candidats.titre: File:Akzhar Chalk Mountains, Kostanay Region, Kazakhstan. September 2024 11.jpg
candidats.description: Geological Description The photograph illustrates a classic example of stratigraphic layering (sedimentation). These "badlands" are composed primarily of sedimentary rocks, including colored clays, marls, and chalk deposits. Mineral Composition: The vibrant color palette is indicative of various oxidation states and mineral content. The deep reds and ochres suggest a high concentration of iron oxides (hematite), while the whites and yellows point to calcium carbonate (chalk) and sulfur compounds or specific clay minerals like kaolinite. Morphology: The rounded, undulating shapes and deep groov
